pipeline: Production flashblocks payload service through LocalInstance, with independent MDBX-backed validator re-execution
primary_metric: Equal-weight mean active_block_build_duration in milliseconds per successful canonical block across the four workloads
boundaries: BasePayloadBuilder::build_payload entry through synchronous finalization return, including provider/context setup, pre-execution, pool selection/metering, EVM execution, assembly, root calculation, JSON serialization and websocket/payload-channel handoff; subtract only time awaiting the explicit inter-flashblock scheduler select

workloads.name: transfer-legacy
workloads.payload: ETH transfers of 1 wei to deterministic new recipients

workloads.name: transfer-azul
workloads.payload: ETH transfers of 1 wei to deterministic new recipients

workloads.name: storage-legacy
workloads.payload: one fresh storage slot written per transaction by fixed EVM bytecode

workloads.name: storage-azul
workloads.payload: one fresh storage slot written per transaction by fixed EVM bytecode

state: Fresh isolated MDBX datadirs from the existing embedded chain-901 genesis fixture for each workload/repetition; deterministic prefunded builder_signer; storage deployment bytecode fixed in harness; builder and validator share fork configuration and block timestamps
cache_policy: Warm process/database cache after two fixed workload blocks; fresh datadirs per process
build: cargo test --locked --release -p base-builder-core --test pipeline_profile --no-run; workspace release profile unchanged; same instrumentation and recorder for both versions
comparison_order: Alternate baseline/candidate order by pair after exploratory baseline collection; no builds or parallel benchmark runs during measurements
confidence_method: Paired workload-weighted run means; two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval on percentage reduction across independent run pairs; add repetitions until lower bound >=15%
guardrail_tolerance: Relative 5% noise tolerance for p95 wall/active latency and peak RSS; zero tolerance for missing transactions, changed gas work, parity failures, or fewer expected flashblocks; full driver latency 5%
acceptance: O <= 0.85 * B and lower 95% confidence bound >=15%; all guardrails and correctness checks pass
limitations: Synthetic production-path workloads on Apple silicon, not a mainnet snapshot or a production-host claim; basic/Denim builders require correctness/control tests and are not silently mixed into this flashblocks baseline
